## Summary
<!-- One or two sentences describing what this PR does and why. -->

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Spec change (modifies `spec/SPEC-vX.Y.md`)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Tooling / CI

## Layer affected (if codec change)
- [ ] L1 — Physical
- [ ] L2 — Data Link (multiplexing)
- [ ] L3 — Network (random access)
- [ ] L4 — Transport (error correction)
- [ ] L5 — Session (semantic tags)
- [ ] L6 — Presentation (compression / encryption)
- [ ] L7 — Application (formats)
- [ ] N/A

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project style (Python: type hints, docstrings; no external deps in core)
- [ ] I have added or updated tests as needed
- [ ] All existing tests pass locally (`pytest reference/tests/` and `node reference/examples/smoke_test.js`)
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (README, SPEC, ROADMAP) where relevant
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
